title: Group the counts
summary: A bar holds a repeating group.

steps.title: Group the counts
steps.body:
**bar** means a group of counts in music, also called a measure. For the next example each bar has four counts: 1, 2, 3, 4; then begin the next group at 1. One chord can stay for more than one bar.

**Why it matters:** Groups tell you how long to keep a chord before the next change.

steps.title: See it on the fretboard
steps.body: Count four while holding G. Clear with Escape, select G again and count four once more. These are two groups with the same chord.

items.prompt: Play G, B and D together. Use any positions for these notes.

steps.title: Explore the sounds
steps.body: Count at a comfortable pace. This lesson checks notes only; it does not grade your timing.
